title: Trouble with the Hubble
question: What is the special importance of a telescope in space?

meanings.usage: 用于观察远处物体的光学仪器
指将火箭、飞船等发射升空
指购买或做某事所需的金钱
形容某事物没有达到期望
描述机器或设备有毛病
指在太空执行任务的人
指由恒星、星云等组成的系统
指所有的空间、物质和能量
指可重复使用的航天器

phrases.usage: 从一开始，表示从一开始就出现问题或情况

examples.en: Right from the start there was trouble with the Hubble.
examples.zh: 从一开始，哈勃望远镜就有问题。

examples.en: NASA is now going to put the telescope right.
examples.zh: 美国国家航空航天局现在准备把望远镜修好。

examples.en: It will soon be sending up four astronauts to repair it.
examples.zh: 它很快将把四名宇航员送上太空去修理它。

examples.en: The shuttle Endeavour will be taking the astronauts to the Hubble.
examples.zh: 奋进号航天飞机将把宇航员送往哈勃望远镜。

examples.en: The astronauts make the necessary repairs.
examples.zh: 宇航员们进行必要的维修工作。

examples.en: The Hubble is above the earth's atmosphere.
examples.zh: 哈勃望远镜在地球大气层之上。

phrases.phrase: tell us a great deal about

examples.en: The Hubble will tell us a great deal about the age and size of the universe.
examples.zh: 哈勃望远镜将告诉我们很多关于宇宙的年龄和大小。

examples.en: By the time you read this, the Hubble's eagle eye will have sent us thousands of pictures.
examples.zh: 到你读到这个的时候，哈勃的鹰眼将已经给我们发送了成千上万的照片。

examples.en: A robot-arm will grab the telescope and hold it while the astronauts make the necessary repairs.
examples.zh: 机械臂将抓住望远镜并保持稳定，而宇航员们进行必要的维修工作。

sentences.en: The Hubble telescope was launched into
space by NASA on April 20, 1990 at a cost of over a billion dollars.
sentences.zh: 1990年4月20日由美国宇航局发射升空的，耗资10多亿美元。

sentences.en: Right from the start there was trouble with the Hubble.
sentences.zh: 哈勃望远镜从一开始就出了毛病。

sentences.en: The pictures it sent us were very disappointing because its main mirror was faulty!
sentences.zh: 它给我们发回的图片非常令人失望，因为它的主镜有缺陷！

sentences.en: NASA is now going to put the telescope right,
sentences.zh: 美国宇航局现在将把望远镜修复好，

sentences.en: so it will soon be sending up four astronauts to repair it.
sentences.zh: 所以它很快将派4名宇航员上去修复它。

sentences.en: The shuttle Endeavour will be taking the astronauts to the Hubble.
sentences.zh: “奋进”号航天飞机将把宇航员送往哈勃。

sentences.en: A robot-arm from the Endeavour will grab the telescope and hold it while the astronauts make the necessary repairs.
sentences.zh: “奋进”号的一个机械臂将抓住望远镜并将其固定住，而宇航员则进行必要的修理。

sentences.en: Of course, the Hubble is above the earth's atmosphere,
sentences.zh: 当然，哈勃望远镜处于地球大气层之外，

sentences.en: so it will soon be sending us the clearest pictures of the stars and distant galaxies that we have ever seen.
sentences.zh: 所以它很快将给我们发回我们从未见过的最清晰的恒星和遥远星系的图片。

sentences.en: The Hubble will tell us a great deal about the age and size of the universe.
sentences.zh: 哈勃望远镜将告诉我们许多关于宇宙的年龄和大小的信息。

sentences.en: By the time you read this, the Hubble's eagle eye will have sent us thousands and thousands of wonderful pictures.
sentences.zh: 当你读到这里时，哈勃的“鹰眼”将已经给我们发回了成千上万张精彩的图片。

exercises.prompt: “表示从过去某时看来将要发生的动作或存在的状态，常用于宾语从句中” 描述的是哪个语法点？
exercises.hint: would + 动词原形 / was/were going to + 动词原形
options: It is now known that... 句型
被动语态（Passive Voice）在不同时间中的应用
过去将来时 (Future in the Past)
must have + 过去分词（对过去的肯定推测）
exercises.explain: 过去将来时 (Future in the Past)：would + 动词原形 / was/were going to + 动词原形：当主句谓语是过去时态时（如said, thought, knew等），宾语从句中要使用过去将来时表示当时认为将要发生的事

source.title: 过去将来时 (Future in the Past)

exercises.prompt:
选出下面句子的正确中文意思：
NASA is now going to put the telescope right,
options: 美国宇航局现在将把望远镜修复好，
不久之后，气球开始下降，并降落在一个机场附近。
于是积蓄了好几年，买了一张真正的床。
exercises.explain: NASA is now going to put the telescope right, — 美国宇航局现在将把望远镜修复好，

source.en: NASA is now going to put the telescope right,

grammar.title: 过去将来时 (Future in the Past)
grammar.definition: 表示从过去某时看来将要发生的动作或存在的状态，常用于宾语从句中
grammar.structure: would + 动词原形 / was/were going to + 动词原形
grammar.usage: 当主句谓语是过去时态时（如said, thought, knew等），宾语从句中要使用过去将来时表示当时认为将要发生的事

examples.en: Right from the start there was trouble with the Hubble. (客观事实)
examples.zh: 从一开始哈勃望远镜就有问题。

examples.en: NASA was going to put the telescope right. (当时计划要做的)
examples.zh: 美国国家航空航天局准备把望远镜修好。

examples.en: By the time you read this, the Hubble's eagle eye will have sent us thousands of wonderful pictures. (将来完成时)
examples.zh: 到你读到这个的时候，哈勃的鹰眼将已经给我们发送了成千上万张精彩的照片。

grammar.title: 将来进行时 (Future Continuous)
grammar.definition: 表示在将来某一时刻或某段时间正在进行的动作
grammar.usage: 用于描述在将来某个时间正在发生的动作，强调动作的进行性

examples.en: It will soon be sending us the clearest pictures of the stars.
examples.zh: 它很快将给我们发送最清晰的星星照片。

examples.en: The shuttle Endeavour will be taking the astronauts to the Hubble.
examples.zh: 奋进号航天飞机将把宇航员送往哈勃望远镜。

grammar.title: 将来完成时 (Future Perfect)
grammar.definition: 表示在将来某一时刻之前已经完成的动作
grammar.usage: 用于描述到将来某个时间为止已经完成的事情，常与by the time等时间状语连用

examples.en: By the time you read this, the Hubble's eagle eye will have sent us thousands of wonderful pictures.
examples.zh: 到你读到这个的时候，哈勃的鹰眼将已经给我们发送了成千上万张精彩的照片。

original.en: The Hubble telescope was launched into space by NASA on April 20, 1990.
original.zh: 哈勃望远镜于1990年4月20日由美国国家航空航天局发射升空。

examples.en: The satellite was launched into space by China last year.
examples.zh: 这颗卫星去年由中国发射升空。

examples.en: A new spacecraft was launched into orbit by SpaceX yesterday.
examples.zh: 昨天SpaceX公司将一艘新宇宙飞船发射到轨道上。

original.en: NASA is now going to put the telescope right.
original.zh: 美国国家航空航天局现在准备把望远镜修好。

examples.en: The company is now going to launch a new product.
examples.zh: 这家公司现在准备推出一款新产品。

examples.en: They are now going to make important changes.
examples.zh: 他们现在准备做出重要的改变。

patterns.pattern: ...will tell us a great deal about...

original.en: The Hubble will tell us a great deal about the age and size of the universe.
original.zh: 哈勃望远镜将告诉我们很多关于宇宙的年龄和大小。

examples.en: This research will tell us a great deal about climate change.
examples.zh: 这项研究将告诉我们很多关于气候变化的信息。

examples.en: The new book will tell us a great deal about history.
examples.zh: 这本新书将告诉我们很多关于历史的知识。

patterns.pattern: By the time..., ...will have + 过去分词

original.en: By the time you read this, the Hubble's eagle eye will have sent us thousands of wonderful pictures.
original.zh: 到你读到这个的时候，哈勃的鹰眼将已经给我们发送了成千上万张精彩的照片。

examples.en: By the time you arrive, I will have finished the work.
examples.zh: 到你到达的时候，我将已经完成这项工作。

examples.en: By the time we get there, the movie will have started.
examples.zh: 到我们到达那里的时候，电影将已经开始了。
